review_kind: author-side bounded editorial source review; no independent adjudication
scope: Eleven selected method, standards/framework and risk-ontology sources are recorded with their actual inspected portions. This completes the bounded public corpus in #8, not a full normative or systematic literature review.
selection_method: Start from the five references already public at commit 7c2eed823a4d1e2df75c43bbdbf13b0c58960b2f; add official ISACA scope sources named by the model and a targeted COVER/ROSE research lineage update. Search primary publisher, author, standards-body and versioned repository records. Retain sources with a stated use in this model; do not rank ontologies by unmeasured quality. Search snippets identify candidates only. Selected public abstracts and selected method text support scope comparisons; they do not substitute for unseen chapters, clauses, experiments or formal mappings. The search is purposive and non-exhaustive through the review date.
historical_boundary: The public baseline had a bibliography but no edition/portion-qualified comparison matrix. This is a new post-prerelease review, not a reconstruction of inaccessible pre-public acquisition records. Retained findings preserve the model's case/record, reference/referent, source-qualified vocabulary and knowledge/process distinctions. The model's historical claim ceiling is not inherited as proof that all source clauses were screened. No private text, unpublished review or reviewer approval is asserted.

sources.citation: OntoUML specification documentation. Role; Relator. Read the Docs, latest channel, accessed 23 October 2026.
sources.version: Mutable latest documentation; no numbered specification release or commit inferred
sources.inspected: Role and Relator definition/constraint tables and prose; example images and the full language were not reviewed in this batch.
sources.finding: Roles depend on relational contexts and inherit identity; relators ground material relations and require mediation with aggregate minimum participation of at least two.

sources.citation: International Organization for Standardization (2018). ISO 31000:2018, Risk management — Guidelines. Second edition, February 2018.

sources.inspected: Official catalog header/status, public overview and certification FAQ; ISO's 15 February 2018 news explanation of risk, context and guidelines.
sources.finding: The public explanation relates risk to uncertainty affecting objectives. Guidance covers organizational risk management and is not a certification requirements standard.
sources.actual_use: Scope screening and the deliberate separation of RiskCase, objective/uncertainty information and a whole management process; not a clause-conformance crosswalk.
sources.limits: Full standard not read. The OBP route exposed a JavaScript shell, not readable clauses. Do not assign an inspected clause number from the news article or infer universal multiplicities.

interpretations.interpretation: Keep conceptual design, operational export and finite CQ tests as distinct evidence layers.
interpretations.restriction: Method influence does not establish full process execution or stakeholder consensus.

interpretations.interpretation: Record purpose, scope and intended use before tracing requirements to evidence.
interpretations.restriction: The inspected abstract supports organization, not full adherence to detailed ORSD guidelines.

interpretations.interpretation: Responsibility roles and relators use relational dependence and mediated participation as conceptual anchors.
interpretations.restriction: Two distinct participants, assignment grounding and mandate identity are reviewed local policies; no complete language-conformance proof follows.

interpretations.interpretation: RiskCase is a governed tracking subject; it is not the uncertainty-related effect described by ISO's public explanation.
interpretations.restriction: Neither RiskCase nor a local Risk Item label is declared universally equivalent to ISO risk.

interpretations.interpretation: Source-qualified nature assertions can retain favorable, unfavorable or mixed effects relative to objective/context references.
interpretations.restriction: This is a representation choice consistent with the inspected public scope; it is not a complete term-by-term normative mapping.

interpretations.interpretation: Preserve framework/version/original meaning on appetite and tolerance statements; retain distinct source meanings in the local contract.
interpretations.restriction: Exact current normative definitions and their cross-edition relationship were not read here. No attribution of either local tolerance meaning to an unseen current clause.

interpretations.interpretation: Riskium retains scenario, treatment and responsibility information; a framework describing enterprise IT risk practice has broader process aims.
interpretations.restriction: The inspected overview does not verify the local scenario structure, mandatory fields or role identity against Risk IT's detailed definitions.

interpretations.interpretation: Recorded responsibility is not implementation of COBIT governance objectives or proof of accountable ownership.
interpretations.restriction: No RACI, APO12, EDM03 or capability assessment has been performed.

interpretations.interpretation: Do not identify a governed RiskCase with COVER's role-mixin RiskSubject or collapse a recorded result into its value/risk conceptualization.
interpretations.restriction: Selected implementation declarations and the paper abstract do not prove cross-ontology alignment; no sameAs/equivalentClass bridge is asserted.

interpretations.interpretation: Both interpretations connect vulnerability to intrinsic dependence; the inspected COVER declaration additionally uses RoleMixin metatyping.
interpretations.restriction: Riskium's local mode/bearer contract is not the same typing decision. Retain this difference for independent review; no equivalence claimed.

interpretations.interpretation: ROSE's abstract concerns security mechanisms and treatment phenomena; Riskium can preserve unresolved control references as information.
interpretations.restriction: A reference or treatment plan proves neither mechanism existence nor effectiveness. No conclusion that ROSE lacks documentary features.

interpretations.interpretation: WATCHDOG's declared computational services are distinct from retrieval of supplied Riskium assessment information.
interpretations.restriction: A SPARQL result is not a risk-propagation calculation, predictive validation or comparative performance result.

interpretations.interpretation: Use conceptual adequacy as a separate evaluation question from executable formal/query services.
interpretations.restriction: Riskium has no implemented attack-tree interoperability or independent semantic acceptance from citing this abstract.

open_limits.limitation: Full ISO/Risk IT/COBIT clause and term-definition crosswalks are unassessed; exact appetite/tolerance and risk-owner interpretations require legitimate source access and qualified review.
All interpretation rows are author-side. Independent adjudication, especially vulnerability typing, case identity and responsibility grounding, remains outstanding.

The selected prior-art comparison is not a systematic review, novelty proof, feature-absence proof or head-to-head benchmark. Full ROSE/WATCHDOG/attack-tree analyses and the access-blocked 2026 candidate are not assessed.

The conceptual source's historical no-fundamental-contradiction statement has no reconstructed historical reading corpus here; this review supports only the explicit inspected-portion findings, not universal compatibility or compliance.

claim_ceiling: Riskium has a discoverable, edition/portion-qualified public source register and explicit bounded comparison findings. No universal standards equivalence, exhaustive contradiction screening, full normative compliance, novel superiority, independent validation or overall semantic-correctness percentage follows. The immutable v0.3.1-rc.1 semantic source and its historical evidence remain unchanged.
